office_does: The prosecuting attorney charges and prosecutes crimes in Whitman County and serves as the legal adviser to county officials.
race_blurb: Uncontested open seat: Prosecuting Attorney Denis Tracy is retiring after six terms, and his chief deputy, Dan LeBeau, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Whitman County deputy prosecutor for more than 20 years and chief deputy since 2016; former Colton Municipal Court judge. Endorsed by the retiring prosecutor and the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Chief deputy prosecutor since 2016 after more than two decades in the office [S1]
Chairs the state bar's Criminal Law Section executive committee; Colton Municipal Court judge 2016-2022 [S1]
Endorsed by retiring Prosecutor Denis Tracy [S3]
